stemMd: Only architects may sign this drawing. Mara signed it in compliance with the rule. What follows?

options.label: D
options.textMd: No architect may refuse to sign.

explanationMd: Compliance means each signer belongs to the permitted group, architects. Mara's signature therefore establishes her membership. The rule does not require all architects to sign or prove sole authorship.

distractorRationale.b: Signing and designing are not equated.
distractorRationale.c: The rule does not specify the group's size.
